sources.identity: HappyHorse CLI 0.1.9 official linux-x64 native bundle

sources.qualification: OAuth/session/membership portions are verified; earlier task/media/refresh placeholders were not treated as authoritative when they differed from official CLI static implementation

sources.reason: official verified static implementation closed all required fields without remote side effects

static_trace: generation command schemas expose no watermark option
generation request builder Zn1 emits no watermark field
task submit builder EV4 changes only modelVersion 1.1 to 1.5
membership policy yE maps operation=download and membership=member to watermarked=false
task API getDownloadUrl serializes slotIndex, watermarked, and aiWater=true into the metadata query
watermark_control_evidence.real_probe_delta: The real-probe task body had no watermark field (correct), while its metadata GET omitted watermarked and aiWater (adapter omission), causing provider defaults to select a visibly watermarked result.
